assumptions: The uncertainty model changes only the second coordinate of the sensing vector (1,1) to (1,1+h).
The formal domain is h^2<=1/36; a,b,c are unrestricted real numbers.
claim: For a symmetric lift difference [[a,c],[c,b]], perturbing the sensing vector (1,1) to (1,1+h), with |h|<=1/6, changes its intensity difference by an error whose square is at most half the squared Frobenius norm of the lift difference.
